attchmntText: Ennature Bio Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Outcome of Board Meeting'.
voiceSummary: Ennature Bio Pharma Limited announced the Board approved Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board meeting was held on 12th November 2026. For the half year ended 30th September 2026, revenue from operations was 16,885.29 Lakhs. Profit before tax was 1,285.54 Lakhs. Profit for the period was 954.64 Lakhs. Earnings per share was 4.27 Rupees. Total assets stood at 70,507.44 Lakhs as at 30th September 2026. The results include accounting effects of the demerger scheme from India Glycols Limited, which became effective on 1st September 2026. Comparative figures have been restated. The financial results were limited reviewed by statutory auditors.

attchmntText: Ennature Bio Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange about change in Management
voiceSummary: Ennature Bio Pharma Limited designated five individuals as Senior Management Personnel effective 12th November, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the appointments following a recommendation from the Nomination and Remuneration Committee. The designated personnel include Shri Amit Arora as Head of Sales and Marketing, Shri Rakesh Kumar Srivastava as Head of Operations, Shri Anand Gupta as Head of Quality Assurance and Regulatory Affairs, Shri Prashant Babu as Deputy General Manager of Research and Development, and Shri Swatantresh Mishra as Deputy General Manager of Human Resources. The Board meeting commenced at 12.19 hours and concluded at 13.35 hours on 12th November, 2026. Details regarding these appointments have been disclosed under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations and are available on the company website.

attchmntText: Ennature Bio Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Amendment to AOA/MOA of the company.
voiceSummary: Ennature Bio Pharma Limited has approved the adoption of a new set of Articles of Association. This decision was taken by the Board of Directors during a meeting held on 12th November 2026. The new Articles aim to align with the Securities Contracts Regulation Rules 1957 and the group's governance framework. The approval is subject to shareholder approval and any other regulatory or statutory approvals required under applicable laws. The Board meeting started at 12:19 Hrs and concluded at 13:35 Hrs. The company is disclosing this information pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.
